Keywords: keyword research seed terms search volume intent head tail
Description: Find the core keywords your target audience uses to find solutions like yours. Start broad, then go long-tail.
Implementation: 1. Brainstorm seed keywords from your product. 2. Expand with related searches. 3. Filter by volume + intent + difficulty.
Tool: Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs, Semrush, Ubersuggest
Do: Focus on intent (informational vs. transactional). Target long-tail for quick wins. Group by topic cluster.
Dont: Don't target head terms only (too competitive). Don't ignore search intent. Don't optimize for volume alone.

Keywords: long tail low competition specific niche buyer intent phrases
Description: Long-tail keywords (3-5+ words) have lower volume but higher conversion rates and less competition. Great for new sites.
Implementation: Find keywords like 'best [product] for [use case]' or '[problem] solution'. Use 'People Also Ask' in Google.
Do: Prioritize keywords with buyer intent. Use FAQ sections. Target 'best', 'vs', 'alternatives', 'how to' keywords.
Dont: Don't ignore long-tail in favor of big terms. Don't stuff long-tails awkwardly into copy.

Keywords: title tag meta title h1 page title click-through rate serp
Description: The page title shown in search results. Most important on-page ranking factor. Should include primary keyword near the front.
Implementation: Keep under 60 characters. Put keyword first. Add brand name at end. Write for clicks
Dont: Include exact match keyword. Write compelling titles that get clicks. Test different formats (how-to, numbers, question).
Impact: Don't stuff keywords. Don't exceed 60 chars (gets cut off). Don't duplicate title tags across pages.

Keywords: meta description snippet search result click through rate persuasion
Description: The 155-char description shown in search results. Doesn't directly affect rankings but massively impacts CTR.
Implementation: Write a compelling 140-155 char description with the keyword and a CTA. Treat it like a mini-ad copy.
Do: Include keyword (it gets bolded in results). Add a clear benefit. Include a CTA like 'Learn more', 'Get started'.
Dont: Don't exceed 155 chars. Don't duplicate. Don't write generic descriptions. Don't forget CTA.

Keywords: h1 h2 h3 headers headings hierarchy outline keyword structure
Description: Headers organize content for readers and help search engines understand page structure. Use keyword-rich headers.
Implementation: One H1 per page (exact/near-exact keyword). H2s for main sections. H3s for sub-points. Include related keywords in H2-H3.
Do: Use one H1. Include keywords in H2s naturally. Match header structure to table of contents. Make headers descriptive.
Dont: Don't use headers just for styling. Don't stuff keywords. Don't skip heading levels.

Description: Google uses Core Web Vitals as ranking signals. LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1 required for good scores.
Tool: lazy load). Minimize JS/CSS. Use CDN. Enable caching. Remove render-blocking resources.

Keywords: sitemap xml crawl index discover pages google search console
Description: A sitemap helps search engines discover and index all your important pages efficiently.
Implementation: Generate XML sitemap automatically (plugin or tool). Submit to Google Search Console. Keep it updated.
Tool: Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Screaming Frog
Do: Include all indexable pages. Exclude noindex pages. Submit to GSC. Update when adding new pages.
Dont: Don't include pages with noindex. Don't include broken URLs. Don't ignore sitemap errors in GSC.

Keywords: internal links anchor text site structure link equity crawlability
Description: Internal links distribute link equity and help search engines crawl and understand your site structure.
Implementation: Add contextual internal links in every piece of content (3-5 per post). Use keyword-rich anchor text. Link to cornerstone pages.
Do: Link from high-authority pages to pages you want to rank. Use descriptive anchor text. Create content silos.
Dont: Don't use 'click here' as anchor text. Don't orphan important pages. Don't over-link (>100 links per page).

Keywords: guest post backlink authority link building outreach blog contribution
Description: Publishing articles on other authoritative sites in your niche to earn editorial backlinks.
Implementation: Find relevant blogs via 'write for us' + niche. Pitch unique
Dont: Target sites with DR 40+. Write genuinely useful content. Include natural, contextual links (not footer/bio only).
Impact: Don't buy links. Don't mass spam pitches. Don't use sites with unrelated niches.

Keywords: digital pr link building press coverage HARO journalist pitch newsjacking
Description: Creating newsworthy content or pitching journalists to earn links from high-authority media sites.
Implementation: Use HARO (Help A Reporter Out). Create data studies/surveys. Pitch unique angles to journalists.
Do: Target domain authority 50+. Offer exclusive data or expert quotes. Build relationships with journalists.
Dont: Don't pitch irrelevant stories. Don't send mass emails without personalization. Don't chase any link for the sake of it.

Keywords: local seo google business profile GMB maps local pack NAP citations
Description: Optimizing your Google Business Profile is the #1 local ranking factor for map pack and local searches.
Implementation: Complete every field in GBP. Add photos weekly. Respond to reviews. Post updates regularly. Ensure NAP consistency.
Do: Keep NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistent everywhere. Get 5-star reviews regularly. Use local keywords in description.
Dont: Don't ignore negative reviews. Don't use a P.O. box as address. Don't leave GBP incomplete.

Keywords: topic cluster pillar page content hub SEO authority depth
Description: A pillar page covers a broad topic, with multiple cluster pages covering subtopics — all interlinked. Signals topical authority.
Implementation: Identify broad pillar topics. Create a comprehensive pillar page. Write 5-10 cluster posts. Interlink all to pillar.
Do: Cover topics comprehensively. Internally link all cluster content to pillar. Update pillar regularly.
Dont: Don't create cluster posts without a pillar. Don't ignore internal linking between cluster posts.

Description: Google rewards fresh, up-to-date content. Refreshing old posts can significantly boost rankings.
Implementation: Audit existing content quarterly. Update stats
